title: Xbox Series X $1049, Digital Edition $899, Series S $749 @Big W
body:
Deal: Xbox Series X $1049, Digital Edition $899, Series S $749 @Big W

[stubbietubbie] Series S for what the Series X was.
F**k AI.
[Wilburre] Absolutely grim. I got a series s 3 months old on eBay for $280 delivered when Oblivion remastered came out. I thought $500 for a brand new one was too expensive.
[Martin31] No reason to buy series s at this price point
[jowo] The main post is missing the $599 512GB Series S ($749 is for the 1TB Series S), which makes a little more sense
The ladder:
$599 Xbox Series S 512GB: https://www.bigw.com.au/product/xbox-series-s-512gb-console/…
$749 Xbox Series S 1TB: https://www.bigw.com.au/product/xbox-series-s-1tb-digital-ed…
$899 Xbox Series X 1TB Digital Edition: https://www.bigw.com.au/product/xbox-series-x-1tb-digital-ed…
$1049 Xbox Series X 1TB (black, with disc drive): https://www.bigw.com.au/product/xbox-series-x-1tb-console/p/…
Apparently the 512GB Series S has about 364GB storage available for games, GTA6 is about 210GB to download.
[TheDukeOfNukem] Yeah, a buddy of mine with an S and an HD D has been lamenting how slow transfer speeds are now that it's hot swapping GTA6 forever basically.
laughs in 2TB Xbox drive when it was around $200
[maverickjohn] Console prices are just stupid (pcparts are no less stupid right now as well). If you are keen to hold.out maybe when the GTA craze settles down it might normalise console prices. Probably won't go back to old pricing but should hopefully get a proper sale price.
These prices are just nuts for an end of life console.. same as PlayStation prices, all just crazy high right now.
[zacsg1] I see the series s 512gb is $581 if I get gift cards, is the only difference half the storage?
Would love to be able to play GTA and Forza but of course this is the worst time to try to buy a console…
[Rated3] All above the original prices for a sale is crazy
[kensaiD] The RAMpocalypse is insane. I paid $749 at launch for my Series X, I would not recommend anyone pay that same price for a Series S.
[scud70] Lol get outa here.. $749 for an S ? 6 years later :|
[MrZ] Almost Black Friday is it? When is Thanksgiving in Australia again?
[Murpha] The Series X missed out on the new FSR 4 tech that the Series S got. Rockstar gimped the game so it didn't out shine the PS5 Pro. At the very least the Series X could have got the more advanced RT shadows….
[Spendmore] It will get it when the base PS5 gets their version.
[TheDukeOfNukem] I love the X and S. And when the S was readily available on sale for 400 all the time, it was fantastic…I just didn't realize how fantastic it was.
(profanity) AI.
[MostlyRidiculous] for someone looking to buy a console, is base PS5 or a Series X a smarter buy? I want to play GTA and I'd probably play Call of Duty as well. I'd use the console for single player AAA titles
[narcoleptic-haze] A small consolation is, I think this is the best hardware generation for Xbox. My launch Series X is still going strong after 6 years (knock on wood!) - not even additional fan noise as is often the case with aging game consoles. I did have to get a new controller recently though.
[CheapandUsed] What a nightmare…
This time 3 years ago the Series X was sold for a 37% discount off the $799 RRP at the time https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/813776
now we can buy it "on sale" for ~132% more than that RRP
[ransworld] Wow… I paid $365 for my Series S before it was even a year old https://www.ozbargain.com.au/node/634479
